diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker correctly set the generator load test window to 0800-1000, the clinic power transfer window to 1000-1200, and the network maintenance window to 1200-1400. This is because these windows are directly determined by the public facts PF1, PF2, and PF3, respectively, which the decision-maker has access to. Specifically, the decision-maker used the exact times provided by PF1, PF2, and PF3 without needing any additional information from other agents.

C1.why: The exact east distribution panel outage changes the generator load-test window to 0800-1000 and requires a facilities control identifying that panel and test window.

C2.why: The vaccine refrigerator requirement changes the clinic transfer window to exactly 1000-1200 and requires a clinic control preserving generator-backed power during that transfer.

C3.why: The exact encryption-key synchronization window changes network maintenance to 1200-1400 and requires a protected-network control identifying synchronization during that window.
